product_metadata.title: Andency Black Quilt Queen(90x96Inch), 3 Pieces (1 Stripe Quilt and 2 Pillowcases) Black and White Patchwork Striped Bedspread Coverlet Set, Soft Microfiber Lightweight Quilted Bedding Set
features: [Striped Quilt] Andency stripe quilt set is designed in black and white patchwork stripes, the black color with white stripes pattern makes the bedspread cover look more elegant and modern. It is never out of date. A gray-black and white stripe quilt will also give your bedroom a stylish decoration, and simple lines tend to be neutral and can easily bring a relaxed mood. It will be suitable and upscale for any room in your house, such as a bedroom, guest room, children's room, vacation room.

[Soft Bedspread Sets] Andency striped quilt set is filled with high-quality microfiber. Compared with other materials, it is softer and more breathable. The premium microfiber bed cover is very soft and comfortable, it's so comfy like sleeping in a cloud. Our striped coverlet can bring you a high-density smooth surface, super soft, and makes you never want to leave your bed. Enjoying a brand new day starts with a perfect sleep.

[What You Can Get] Queen size quilt set includes 1 striped bedspread(96 x 90 inches) and 2 pillowcases (20 x 26 inches ); King size quilt set includes 1 stripe bedspread(106 x 96 inches) and 2 pillowcases (20 x 36 inches ), Cal King quilt set includes 1 stripe bedspread(104 x 112 inches) and 2 pillowcases (20 x 36 inches ). If you wish the bedding coverlet is a little longer to cover more of the side of the bed, you may have a low bed or choose a larger size.

[Exquisite Stitching] Our quilted coverlet adopt delicate 3 separate layers carefully stitching together, which not only make the filling of the quilt evenly distributed but also effectively prevent the stuffing from caking and shifting. Exquisite stitching and seams on all edges will keep well even after many washes, it can be used for a long year. A perfect coverlet quilt in spring and summer. In the winter, you can add a comforter underneath and use it as a bedspread.

[Easy Care] High-quality striped bed cover is easy to wash by machine. Please wash separately, tumble dry on low-temperature iron when needed. Please do not bleach and dry clean. Queen striped quilt coverlet won't fade or have a little fuzzball after wash. Since the quilt is vacuum packaging in transit, it will arrive shriveled and wrinkled. it's highly recommended that the bedspread be baked in the sun and tapped gently during baking for fluffy.
